name: B10-0054/2025 (The Left) – Need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns the Belarusian government for oppressing its people and for holding elections that are not free or fair. It asks for the release of people jailed for political reasons. It calls on the European Union and its member states to make visas easier for people fleeing Belarus and to give them practical and financial help. It also calls for talks with opposition groups and civil society.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects the Belarusian government, political prisoners and people fleeing Belarus.
- Next, the text goes to the Council, the Commission, member states and the Belarusian authorities.
